test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is '**Assasinate**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The incorrectly spelled word is: ***Assasinate***.

 
 
• **The correct spelling of the word is- Assassinate** (हत्या करना - महत्वपूर्ण व्यक्ति को राजनीतिक या धार्मिक कारणों से) - to murder (an important person) for political or religious reasons. 

 
 
• Example: The organization's leader
